title: Create your first circular genome figure
summary: Upload one small GenBank record, choose a circular preset, show feature labels and GC tracks, and export the result without running a sequence search.

downloads.label: NC_012920.1
downloads.note: Download the complete record as a GenBank flat file and keep this filename.

manualSteps.title: Select Circular mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and select Circular. This workflow uses one annotated GenBank file and does not need Pairwise Comparisons.

manualSteps.title: Upload the record and name the output
manualSteps.body: Upload the GenBank record, then enter the output and center-label text.

media.caption: Upload HmmtDNA.gbk in the Circular input card.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const file = app?.files?.c_gb; if (!file) throw new Error('HmmtDNA GenBank file was not restored.'); app.files.c_gb = new File([file], 'HmmtDNA.gbk', { type: file.type, lastModified: file.lastModified }); app.form.prefix = 'HmmtDNA_basic_circular'; app.form.species = 'Homo sapiens'; app.form.track_type = 'middle'; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.suppress_gc = false; app.form.suppress_skew = false; app.form.labels_mode = 'out'; app.adv.circular_track_slots_enabled = false; const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label')).find((node) => node.textContent.trim() === 'GenBank/DDBJ File'); const uploader = label?.parentElement?.parentElement; if (!uploader) throw new Error('Circular GenBank uploader was not found.'); uploader.dataset.capture = 'hmmt-genbank-upload'; uploader.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

media.alt: Basic settings with the HmmtDNA output prefix and Homo sapiens species text.
media.caption: Set Output Prefix and Species for the mitochondrial figure.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; const file = app?.files?.c_gb; if (!file) throw new Error('HmmtDNA GenBank file was not restored.'); app.files.c_gb = new File([file], 'HmmtDNA.gbk', { type: file.type, lastModified: file.lastModified }); app.form.prefix = 'HmmtDNA_basic_circular'; app.form.species = 'Homo sapiens'; app.form.track_type = 'middle'; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.suppress_gc = false; app.form.suppress_skew = false; app.form.labels_mode = 'out'; app.adv.circular_track_slots_enabled = false;

manualSteps.title: Choose the compact layout and labels
manualSteps.body: Use the compact Middle preset, keep both GC tracks visible, and place feature labels outside the circle.

media.alt: Circular Layout controls with Middle selected, Separate Strands checked, and both Hide GC controls unchecked.
media.caption: Select Middle, enable Separate Strands, and leave both Hide GC controls off.

actions.script: const app = window.__GBDRAW_APP__; app.form.track_type = 'middle'; app.form.separate_strands = true; app.form.suppress_gc = false; app.form.suppress_skew = false; app.form.labels_mode = 'out'; app.adv.circular_track_slots_enabled = false; const card = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card')).find((node) => node.querySelector('summary')?.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().startsWith('Layout')); const summary = card?.querySelector('summary'); const preset = Array.from(card?.querySelectorAll('label') || []).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Track Preset'))?.closest('div'); const options = Array.from(card?.querySelectorAll('label') || []).find((node) => node.textContent.includes('Separate Strands'))?.closest('.grid'); if (!summary || !preset || !options) throw new Error('Circular layout controls were not found.'); summary.dataset.capture = 'hmmt-layout-summary'; preset.dataset.capture = 'hmmt-layout-preset'; options.dataset.capture = 'hmmt-layout-options'; preset.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });

media.alt: Circular Label Mode selector with Out highlighted.
media.caption: Set Label Mode to Out.

manualSteps.title: Generate and export SVG
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. Check that features, labels, GC content, and GC skew are visible, then use SVG in the export controls.

media.alt: Circular human mitochondrial genome diagram with feature and GC tracks.
media.caption: The completed figure requires no sequence-search step.
